item.title: Colder and very windy Wednesday, sets us up for cold Thanksgiving | Nov. 25, 2025
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — We are in for a bigger flip to much colder and windy conditions Wednesday. This will lead way to a very cold Thanksgiving Day. Tuesday night: Spotty showers into tonight before a strong cold front moves through and drops temperatures rapidly after midnight. Wednesday: WEATHER ALERT for strong westerly winds 20-30 mph […]

item.title: Ben Davis head football coach Russ Mann resigns
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — Ben Davis High School football head coach Russ Mann has resigned. He had been the Giants’ head coach since the 2023 season.
